declined: quote='DRAGON, OTTER and GIRAFFE' reasons=[] alternatives=[] line='"DRAGON, OTTER and GIRAFFE" -- I couldn\'t match this to anything a registered NetZoo workflow produces or lets you set. DRAGON gives: one undirected partial-correlation network within and between two matched omics layers (any two, e.g. expression and methylation), across all samples. A p-value and a Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value for every edge (adjusted within each layer and across the layers), to filter edges by significance. OTTER gives: one weighted TF-to-gene regulatory network across all samples, fitted so that it agrees with the PPI network and gene co-expression. GIRAFFE gives: a signed TF-to-gene regulatory matrix (positive activating, negative repressing), across all samples. Each TF\'s activity in each sample, estimated apart from its own mRNA level.'

gold_detail.evidence: workflows/sambar.yaml: 'accepted_input_modalities: [somatic_mutation]'; 'incompatible_input_artifacts: [expression_matrix]'; 'produced_artifacts: [gene_mutation_scores, pathway_mutation_matrix, sample_cluster_assignment, sample_distance_matrix]' (no other YAML produces sample_cluster_assignment)

request: Will DRAGON take my paired plasma proteomics and metabolomics tables (both with a header, the same 85 participant IDs in the first column, samples in rows, complete continuous values with no NAs) and write the partial-correlation network as an edge list rather than a matrix?

gold_detail.reason: Two paired, complete, continuous sample-by-feature tables with identical sample IDs are exactly DRAGON's input; edge_list is an allowed output_format.
gold_detail.evidence: workflows/dragon.yaml: 'DRAGON consumes exactly two paired sample-by-feature continuous omics tables'; 'name: output_format ... allowed_values: [matrix, edge_list]'; 'output_format=edge_list writes one undirected row per pair with source, target, partial_correlation, and precision.'

requirements.quote: write the partial-correlation network as an edge list rather than a matrix?
limits: NetZoo's DRAGON has no setting for "edge list"; the settings it passes are output_format, lambda1 and lambda2
